Container.Name: appvault
Container.Overview: AppVault server. Stores macOS apps offloaded from your Mac so you can restore them when needed. The library lives on the mounted Storage path, never inside the container. Each category is a folder.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Port the Mac app connects to.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Share where app archives are stored. One folder per category.

Config.Name: API Token
Config.Description: Secret token (min 16 chars). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 24. Enter the same token in the Mac app.
